answer: Each new identity needs an attestor who locks a 200-credit ferrous bond and posts the attestation on the lagoon registry, auditors recount per key. The attestor pays a fee equal to the square of the attestation number: first 1 credit, thousandth 1,000,000, and the counter never resets. The kth fake costs 200 plus k squared credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 334,033,500. A rented-attestor ring fails because key reuse shows on the lagoon registry, and auditors sink reused bonds in the karst sink and freeze the cluster. An honest attestor pays 1 credit and one bond, returned after a clean epoch.
